method: Production grabber and walking lifecycle in isolated PhysX at 0.005-second steps. Actual dynamic box, floor, wall and player capsule contacts. No changes to the open scene or assets.
scope: Physics, eligibility and lifecycle checks. Native pointer capture, E/click priority, wheel and right-mouse feel still require the real browser player.

checks.name: only marked loose cartons are eligible
checks.expectation: Reject unmarked, heavy, oversized, kinematic, jointed and pallet bodies; allow one small marked dynamic carton.

checks.name: aim volume respects the nearest surface
checks.expectation: A slight edge aim picks the carton, but a solid wall blocks both aim and direct pickup.

checks.name: a stacked delivery carton lifts off its support
checks.expectation: A settled top carton follows toward the player and lifts clear of its supporting carton without a false blocked-sweep release.

checks.name: bounded physical hold
checks.expectation: The actual body rises under force without parenting or an immediate pose write, settles within 4 cm, and never exceeds the force budget.

checks.name: maximum carry mass can be lifted
checks.expectation: A 25 kg carton rises and settles under the same finite 650 N force limit while a heavier carton is refused.

checks.name: wheel distance has physical limits
checks.expectation: Distance adjustment is bounded and moves the real carton to both ends of its permitted range.

checks.name: whole carton stops before a wall
checks.expectation: The actual carton stays on the near side of a thin wall with less than 1 cm penetration while the requested distance extends beyond it.

checks.name: carrying fits low overhead clearance
checks.expectation: A tilted carton stays held below a low roof even when the eye-centred box would overlap it; actual roof, side walls and a new near obstruction remain physical.

checks.name: turning through the front doorway keeps freight physical
checks.expectation: The actual porch pickup can turn toward the front door and walk through it, waiting at a briefly obstructed target instead of releasing or penetrating masonry.

checks.name: collection route handles the driver and real van
checks.expectation: The recorded carry uses production walking past the driver and along the pavement, climbs the authored ramp, enters the cargo van, sets down upright stock and walks back out.

checks.name: lowering respects the floor
checks.expectation: Looking down lowers the carton physically, preserves the floor contact and permits a stable gravity-driven setdown.

checks.name: rotation uses physical torque
checks.expectation: Right-mouse rotation keeps the view still, applies no immediate pose write and rotates the real box with bounded angular speed.

checks.name: looking preserves the picked carton orientation
checks.expectation: Pickup retains the original orientation and ordinary camera yaw and pitch do not rotate the held box.

checks.name: rotation cannot sweep through a wall
checks.expectation: An elongated held carton rotates against a wall while its actual collision body stays within 1.5 cm of the wall boundary.

checks.name: release restores the free body
checks.expectation: Setdown retains a dynamic collider and gravity, restores original solver settings and player collision, caps release energy and falls to the floor.

checks.name: player collision is restored only after separation
checks.expectation: A released carton overlapping the capsule cannot push the player; collision returns after separation and pre-existing ignore rules are preserved.

checks.name: pause and control transfers release immediately
checks.expectation: Browser inactivity, external UI, vehicle entry, camera transition and reset each release the carton without moving it to a new location.

checks.name: unreachable cartons are dropped
checks.expectation: A large camera displacement releases immediately; real body occlusion brakes during its short grace period and then releases without pulling through the wall.

checks.name: legacy parcels remain distinct
checks.expectation: A physical carton sets CarryingObject without CarryingParcel; a legacy parcel blocks carton pickup and retains both legacy carry properties.
